bosses.name: Abyss Siren
bosses.description: Signal predator that manipulates flare echoes.
bosses.description_zh: 操纵显形回波的信号型掠食者。

phases.label: Silence Discipline
phases.description: Noise-control exam. If player noise spikes, Siren enrages.
phases.description_zh: 控噪试炼。玩家噪声飙升时，海妖会进入狂怒。
phases.telegraph_text: Mechanics test I: keep noise low
phases.telegraph_text_zh: 机制测试 I：保持低噪
phases.exam_objective: 控噪：噪声超过阈值会触发 Boss 强化与减伤

phases.label: False Resonance
phases.description: Lighting exam. Siren hides behind false echoes until flare reveal.
phases.description_zh: 显形试炼。海妖会藏在伪回波后，直到被显形。
phases.telegraph_text: Mechanics test II: light the true core
phases.telegraph_text_zh: 机制测试 II：照出真正核心
phases.exam_objective: 打光：不在照明窗口内几乎无法有效输出

phases.label: Razor Sweep
phases.description: Movement exam. Read telegraphs and reposition before impact.
phases.description_zh: 走位试炼。读懂预警并在命中前完成 reposition。
phases.telegraph_text: Mechanics test III: dodge the sweep
phases.telegraph_text_zh: 机制测试 III：躲开横扫
phases.exam_objective: 走位：读线躲避，原地硬吃会承受重击

phases.label: Ritual Core
phases.description: Summon-break exam. Boss shield stays up until summoned anchors are cleared.
phases.description_zh: 破召唤试炼。清空祭仪锚点前，Boss 护盾不会解除。
phases.telegraph_text: Mechanics test IV: break the ritual summons
phases.telegraph_text_zh: 机制测试 IV：击破祭仪召唤物
phases.exam_objective: 破召唤：清空祭仪仆从后 Boss 护盾解除

bosses.name: Customs Leviathan
bosses.description: A chain-armored deepwater warden that clamps down on contraband routes and punishes stalled movement.
bosses.description_zh: 披挂锁甲的深水缉私兽，会封死走私航道，并惩罚停滞不前的闯入者。

phases.label: Toll Ward
phases.description: Opening shield exam. The Leviathan braces behind customs crews until their toll anchors are broken.
phases.description_zh: 开场护盾考验。击破税印守卫前，巨鲛会一直架着减伤硬顶在前面。
phases.telegraph_text: Mechanics test I: break the toll anchors
phases.telegraph_text_zh: 机制测试 I：先打掉税印守卫
phases.exam_objective: 破封锁：先清掉税印守卫，再压 Leviathan 本体

phases.label: Inspection Sweep
phases.description: Movement exam. The Leviathan traces a long sweep and punishes anyone who fails to break the line.
phases.description_zh: 走位考验。巨鲛会拉出一整段巡检扫线，没及时脱离的人会被重创。
phases.telegraph_text: Mechanics test II: outrun the inspection sweep
phases.telegraph_text_zh: 机制测试 II：冲出巡检扫线
phases.exam_objective: 机动：冲出巡检线，不要原地吃满整段扫击

phases.label: Static Tariff
phases.description: Noise exam. Spiking noise feeds the Leviathan's static pulse and narrows the damage window.
phases.description_zh: 控噪考验。噪声过高会喂大静电脉冲，同时压缩你的输出窗口。
phases.telegraph_text: Mechanics test III: keep the audit static low
phases.telegraph_text_zh: 机制测试 III：压低审计静电
phases.exam_objective: 控噪：噪声过高会让关税脉冲更快更痛

phases.label: Cargo Seizure
phases.description: Closing shield exam. Seizure crews flood the floor and the Leviathan stays braced until they're broken again.
phases.description_zh: 收尾护盾考验。扣押小队会灌满战场，在清掉之前巨鲛会重新架起减伤。
phases.telegraph_text: Mechanics test IV: clear the seizure crews
phases.telegraph_text_zh: 机制测试 IV：先清掉扣押小队
phases.exam_objective: 清舱：先打掉扣押小队，否则本体持续减伤
